# requires: wire
#
# The server answers a resume with 416: the offset on disk is past the end of
# what it holds, and the whole file is still there for the asking. Nothing about
# the record changes between attempts, so classing this as "not now" produces
# the same 416 on every sweep until a person deletes the partial by hand.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:range416
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-E7]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 7: ok -
